title: policy-grounded guidance: charge after cancellation is eligible for a billing review (60 days); no refund promised
customerSaid: My email is jordan.reyes@customer.example and my account number is NF-100234.
agentReply: I see that you are asking about a charge that occurred after you cancelled your subscription. Based on the information you provided, since your account was charged after your cancellation request, this charge is eligible for a billing review. A billing review allows the billing team to examine the charge, though it does not guarantee an automatic refund. Reviews are normally decided within 5 business days, and you will be informed of the outcome.
